name: adminEmployeeTrainingNeedApplication
description: Lets an Admin submit a training need application on behalf of one or more employees, company-wide (no reporting-line restriction). Resolves every named employee (employees) FIRST via the real 'Select Employee' modal's org-wide search flow (GetEmployeeSearch -> Search -> GetSearchList -> GetEmpNumber -> GetSearchedEmployeeDetails). Once confirmed, identify the need (existingNeedName or newNeedName/newNeedDescription); objective, relevance to job, benefit to employee, and benefit to company are collected only if the server requires them (per-client config). Files uploaded via the Beacon chat attach automatically. Then runs the real validate-then-save flow (ValidateNeedApplication -> SaveNeedApplication) with reqtypecode 000007. Write tool - submits real applications, one per named employee, on success. Draft - GetSearchedEmployeeDetails not yet captured/tested for this module.
taskName: Submitting a Training Need Application (Admin, for Any Employee)
